purpose: Correct only generated-tool image directory permissions after the first COPY-only image failed nonroot readability. Frozen tool/usage bytes, base images and later approved optional exposure are unchanged.
authorization: Pending exact operator approval because this adds one trusted chmod RUN step to each previously COPY-only Dockerfile.
storage_rules: Before each operation inspect host free bytes and Docker usage. Training snapshot envelope 57*(measured snapshot+64MiB), plus50GiB reserve; stop new dispatch below51GiB. Builds require50GiB reserve+2GiB image allowance. No prior-resource cleanup.

image_scope.method: Use the same exact local base IDs; COPY exact frozen bytes, run only existing /bin/chmod 0555 on the new directory, return to65534:65534. No generated-source execution, installation, pulls, network or credential mounts during build/inspection. Require base layer prefix plus exactly two added layers, unchanged final image config, files0444/root-owned and directory0555 before use.
image_scope.cleanup: Retain verified images for remaining work and rollback. Remove only new owned ephemeral workers; never touch older images, volumes or backups.

arms: same medium model plus optional exact generated tool
later_execution_scope.original_grant: onboarding; preserve all counters and expiry
later_execution_scope.network: Existing reviewed model proxy only; no new destinations. Tool itself has no network access.
later_execution_scope.credential_handling: Existing protected worker volumes managed by Codex; no agent reading or copying authentication.
later_execution_scope.review_gate: Freeze exact post-build image IDs, worker bindings, conformance, tool lineage, utility and fresh cases before study enqueue. Candidate use and tool use optional. No automatic source edits, retries, admission or publication.

static_findings: Source read in full: io/json/sys/tokenize only; stdin/stdout data transformation, no file opening, network, subprocess, eval or dynamic imports.
Usage requests Python 3.11. This experiment uses the already reviewed Python 3.13 image; record compatibility only for its bounded training cases, without a Python 3.11 compatibility claim.
No source or grader repair after results. Preserve imperfect or failed training evidence. Reusable model arm remains optional.
The original 28 construction inputs are reused intentionally. This manual v2 diagnostic does not alter the frozen qualification case set and cannot qualify or admit the tool.
rollback: No host package activation or dependency installation. Ephemeral workers are removed by existing runner. Keep exact new image IDs pending completion; later removal requires verifying all container references and explicit cleanup authority.

new_execution_scope.context_delta: Two Dockerfiles add USER root; existing /bin/chmod 0555 on new directory; USER65534:65534. Source and usage hashes unchanged.
